text: PM-AJAY'S FOOTER SAYS WHO OWNS THE PORTAL. Two screens of one portal carried two different credit lines — one dated 2025 naming NIC, the other naming nobody — and both sets of links went nowhere. There is now one footer for the portal, in the form DBIM 3.0 §5.6 sets for a Central Government Department: the lineage sentence, the developer credit the Department publishes on its own website, and the date the content was last updated, which GIGW asks for. Its four links — Website Policies, Privacy Policy, Accessibility Statement, Help — go to pages the estate actually publishes.
